title: An Information Bottleneck for Post-hoc Memorization Mitigation in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.07669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies have shown that large language models (LLMs) can memorize and reproduce copyrighted training data, raising serious privacy and intellectual property concerns. In this work, we investigate whether memorization can be mitigated without modifying or retraining the underlying model through an information bottleneck. We propose a modular plug-and-play framework that inserts a nonparametric variational information bottleneck (NVIB) between a frozen LLM backbone and its language modeling head. By compressing the final hidden representations before token prediction, the proposed bottleneck aims to preserve general linguistic knowledge while filtering out highly specific memorized sequences. We evaluate our approach on memorization extraction tasks involving book passages and on standard language modeling benchmarks to measure the trade-off between memorization reduction and downstream utility. translated_abstract: 最近的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）能够记忆并复现受版权保护的训练数据，引发了严重的隐私和知识产权问题。在本工作中，我们研究了能否通过信息瓶颈在不修改或重新训练底层模型的情况下缓解记忆化问题。我们提出了一个模块化的即插即用框架，在冻结的LLM骨干网络与其语言建模头之间插入一个非参数变分信息瓶颈（NVIB）。通过在词元预测之前压缩最终的隐藏表示，所提出的瓶颈旨在保留通用的语言知识，同时过滤掉高度特定的已记忆序列。我们在涉及书籍段落的记忆化提取任务以及标准语言建模基准上评估了我们的方法，以衡量记忆化减少与下游效用之间的权衡。我们的实验表明，NVIB能够...
tldr: 提出一种即插即用的非参数变分信息瓶颈（NVIB），插入冻结的大语言模型骨干与语言建模头之间，通过压缩隐藏表示在不修改或不重训模型的情况下过滤记忆化内容、保留通用语言知识。
en_tdlr: A plug-and-play nonparametric variational information bottleneck (NVIB) inserted between a frozen LLM backbone and its language modeling head compresses final hidden representations to filter out memorized sequences while preserving general linguistic knowledge, mitigating memorization without modifying or retraining the model.
